title: Rakugaki Jam

summary.en: Doodle on your phone, then fling it onto a shared wall screen — a live, crowd-drawn VJ jam.
summary.jp: スマホに描いた落書きを、壁の共有画面へ投げ飛ばす。みんなで描くライブ VJ。

mine: Designed the doodle-to-wall-screen concept — draw on your phone, fling it onto a shared display
Built the realtime multi-device pairing and sync on Snap Pair and Firebase RTDB
Built the canvas rendering and fling interaction

challenge.en: Shared-screen sketch tools either trap everyone on one device or turn into laggy whiteboards. We wanted the energy of hallway graffiti — private mark-making, public flight — without an app install ceremony.
challenge.jp: 共有画面のスケッチは、一台に押し込むか、遅いホワイトボードになりがち。廊下の落書きのような勢い — 個人で描いて、公の場へ飛ばす — を、インストール儀式なしで欲しかった。

solution.en: Phone canvases pair into a room display; a fling gesture commits the mark to the wall. Snap-pair keeps setup under a minute. The decisive move was separating *draw* (intimate) from *publish* (theatrical).
solution.jp: スマホのキャンバスを部屋の画面にペアし、フリックで壁へ載せる。Snap Pair で準備は 1 分以内。決定打は「描く（親密）」と「出す（劇場）」を分けること。

_notes: Thumbnail, still and preview come from the 2026-09 screen recordings (assets/rakugaki-jam/masters/).

cardLine.en: Doodle on your phone, fling it onto the wall.
cardLine.jp: スマホで落書きして、壁へ飛ばす。
